SK Dynamo České Budějovice is a professional football club from České Budějovice, Czech Republic. The club played in the Czech First League for 24 seasons, but was relegated in 2025. From 2026, the club plays in the Bohemian Football League, after it failed to meet the conditions for obtaining a license for professional competition and was administratively relegated from the Czech National Football League.
